label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button's disabled state is set before the export request starts but is never reset when the request fails, only on success. The error path needs to re-enable the button (e.g. in a catch/finally block) so users can retry without reloading the page.

input.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Currently the button's busy/disabled state is only cleared when the export succeeds. When the export fails (e.g. the server returns an error), the component never resets that state, leaving the button greyed out until the page is reloaded. The fix is to clear the busy/disabled state in the export's failure path as well as its success path (e.g. in a `finally` block or an explicit error handler), so the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.
